text: おなじ　レベルの　ポケモンでも　つよさは　まちまち　らしい　それに　ひとが　そだてた　ポケモンの　ほうが　やせい　より　つよい　らしい

structure.jp: おなじ　レベルの　ポケモンでも
structure.en: even Pokémon of the same level

structure.jp: つよさは　まちまち　らしい
ひとが　そだてた　ポケモンの　ほうが
やせい　より　つよい　らしい
structure.en: are apparently stronger than wild ones

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.explanation: らしい at the end says this is something the speaker heard, not something he knows for sure. まちまち　らしい = 'apparently it varies'.

patterns.name: 〜より (comparison)
patterns.span: ポケモンの　ほうが　やせい　より　つよい
patterns.explanation: AのほうがBより means 'A is more so than B'; より comes after the thing that loses the comparison. ポケモンの　ほうが　やせい　より　つよい = 'the Pokémon are stronger than wild ones'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ひとが　そだてた　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed before a noun describes that noun, like 'that' in English. ひとが　そだてた　ポケモン = 'Pokémon that people raised'.
